purpose: Versioned runtime asset bundle for RA3 1.12. Loaded once per process by RuntimeAssetRuntime on the game thread; templates are addressable by InstanceID after the bundle enters the global asset tree. v3 merges the GameObject injection set (4 GameObject + 3 Raya AttributeModifier) with the v2 AttributeModifier ladder into a single evolving bundle; Tesla weapon same-ID overrides are deliberately excluded. v2 content (bit-weight templates completing the 2-128 integer multiplier mask for RATE_OF_FIRE/DAMAGE_MULT/HEALTH_MULT/RANGE and the 1-128 multiplicative mask for SPEED; all v1 InstanceIDs) is preserved unchanged. v4 appends the ascension bit-weight ladders (441 templates: positive integer weights +1..+64 for the 29 non-ladder types and negative binary fractions -1/2..-1/128 for all 34 types; SPEED negatives are multiplicative factors 1/2..1/128). v5 appends the manually spawned Arsenal MCV chain, its construction/factory command sets, and five campaign-unit production aliases. v6 adds Raya-owned clones of two real neutral artillery defenses and one civilian house; v7 adds the Japanese Floating Fortress three-barrel Wave-Force cannon building. Regular faction artillery, mobile Wave-Force/V4 units and map-only shell objects remain excluded.

compatibilityContract.frozenInstanceIds: InstanceIDs that have entered a Snapshot contract are never reused or resemanticized. New bit-weight templates are append-only.
compatibilityContract.saveDependency: Saves referencing custom modifier InstanceIDs require this exact bundle (same packageVersion and stream hashes) loaded before the save is read. Missing-bundle save load is a documented crash boundary; the trainer auto-loads and verifies the bundle before the user can enter the load-save flow.
compatibilityContract.noHotUnload: The global asset bundle stays registered for the process lifetime. Only per-object modifier entries are loaded/unloaded.
